n2-set-7-q-53.translation: Because their daughters and sons are no longer young, the parents are desperate too.
n2-set-7-q-53.correctAnswerEnglish: wakakunai to atte / 若くないとあって - because they are no longer young.

choices.reason: 若いからといって would mean just because they are young, opposite to the urgency.
若いからこそ gives their youth as the reason, contrary to the parents' desperation.
若くないとはいえ concedes they are not young, but does not supply the cause of 親も必死.
若くないとあって gives the children's age as the reason the parents are desperate.

n2-set-7-q-54.translation: Many people say that, as adults, they should at least find their own marriage partner without relying on their parents.
n2-set-7-q-54.correctAnswerEnglish: kurai wa / くらいは - at least this much; finding one's own spouse is the minimum expected.

choices.reason: のみは means only, not the minimum expectation expressed in the criticism.
くらいは naturally marks choosing one's own partner as the least an adult should do.
さえ would emphasize even a spouse, but lacks the measured minimum of くらいは in this sentence.
こそ emphasizes precisely the marriage partner, not the at-least standard.
